## Skills
Python, TensorFlow/Keras, scikit-learn, Ultralytics YOLO (v5/v8), OpenCV, LLM fine-tuning,

## Selected work
- Alzheimer's MRI classification (research collab with a PhD scholar): ResNet50+DenseNet121
  ensemble with attention, class-weighted training for 50:1 imbalance, 92.18% test accuracy on ~10.9k scans.
- Architecture Diagram Generator: fine-tuned LLM that turns plain-English system descriptions
  into editable React Flow diagrams.
- Virtual Try-On system (VITON-HD / PyTorch); Package Label Prediction on Jetson Nano for a factory.
- PPE Detection and real-time Fire & Smoke Detection (custom-trained YOLO, OpenCV).
- Fine-tuned, research-grounded LLM (Phi-3 + RAG + QLoRA) for a university placement bureau.
- Multi-agent business platforms (CRM/BI/meeting agents) built during the Visibility Bots internship.
